story: At 7:17 on a mild Tuesday evening in Sumter Oaks, Gary and Donna are working through slow, knee-friendly dinking drills on court one at the Rec Center, with Donna clearly enjoying herself. Over at Gary's house, Hal is measuring the exterior modifications on Gary's golf cart and checking them against the community review form, doing his duty with a steady hand. Meanwhile, Rosa is pinning a cheerful note to the bulletin board on Magnolia Loop, inviting all the neighbors to a welcome dinner Friday at six, with roast pork and flan on the menu.
events: Gary (pickleball court 1): Work through slow kitchen-line dinking drills with Donna, easy on the knees
Donna (pickleball court 1): Step onto court one with Gary and start slow, gentle kitchen-line dinking drills
Hal (gary golf cart): Measure the exterior modifications and check them against the review form
Rosa (street bulletin board): Pin up a note: Welcome dinner at Rosa's, Friday at 6, roast pork and flan, all neighbors welcome

gary.thought_process: Donna's started me on kitchen-line dinking drills and Rosa's already gone, so I shouldn't repeat the chair or flan talk. Both memories say the lesson is underway and I'm at the rec center with Donna right here. The best move is to just do the drill, take it slow on the knees, and keep my cart project for after the lesson. I filed the review request at tick 369, so I'm waiting on approval anyway.

parameters.content: Work through slow kitchen-line dinking drills with Donna, easy on the knees

donna.thought_process: It's 7:17 PM and Gary and I are in the Rec Center with court one waiting. He said he's ready, knees warmed up, so there's no need to ask again. Time to actually get on court and start slow kitchen-line dinking drills, keeping the pace gentle for his knees. He's already agreed to Friday at Rosa's, so I can drop that. Action beats chatter. The court is only reserved for two hours max under L-05, so I should make the hour count.

parameters.content: Step onto court one with Gary and start slow, gentle kitchen-line dinking drills

hal.thought_process: I'm at Gary's house and nobody's in sight. My memory says I wanted Gary's cart form measurements checked before the review committee sees it, and the golf cart is right here. I'm a by-the-book man: check the cart's exterior mods against the form so Gary files it correctly. Doing it proper now saves him trouble on Tuesday, and it's the fair thing to do before I report anything to the committee.

parameters.content: Measure the exterior modifications and check them against the review form

rosa.thought_process: Donna, Gary, and Hal have all said yes to Friday's dinner, so I don't need to chase anyone. I've just arrived on Magnolia Loop and nobody is around. The street bulletin board is a good low-effort way to post a friendly reminder about Friday at six at my place, which also welcomes anyone else on the street and keeps community-building going without pestering my guests again.

parameters.content: Pin up a note: Welcome dinner at Rosa's, Friday at 6, roast pork and flan, all neighbors welcome

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
